**Boss:** [Commantis](#loc=75362)

Note: Secret Portals are all super-powered versions of bosses from the game's plot. See the boss' map marker for strategies.
75362:
**Weaknesses:** Ice, Slow

Commantis will spend most of the fight circling the arena and spamming ranged attacks at Riku. Instead of dodging and keeping away, the best strategy is to bring the fight to Commantis. Stay up close, but be ready to slide away if Commantis leaps into the air for its Mine Shower attack. Be especially careful of the blue mines; these speed up your Drop Gauge.

After a third of its health is gone, Commantis will attempt to regain its health by draining energy from the environment. This will repeat when two-thirds of its health is gone. Use Reality Shift to stop Commantis from regaining any health.
